acceptanceCriteria.criterion: next-intl is installed and configured as the i18n solution
5 locales are supported: English (en - default), French (fr), Italian (it), Spanish (es), German (de)
Locale routing works via /[locale]/ URL prefix: /en/, /fr/, /it/, /es/, /de/ serve respective content
Language switcher in the header is functional: clicking changes URL locale prefix, page content updates, current selection is visually indicated
Message files structure exists for all 5 locales: src/messages/en.json (complete), src/messages/fr.json, src/messages/it.json, src/messages/es.json, src/messages/de.json
Middleware detects browser locale: first visit auto-detects browser's preferred language, redirects to appropriate locale if supported, falls back to English if not
useTranslations() hook works in components: Header navigation links, Footer content, LocaleSwitcher are translated, all static text uses translation keys

International support requirement for 5 languages: en, fr, it, es, de. Multi-language accessibility for broader market reach.
